name: Astraeos
summary: Astraeos is a paid, official, and non-canonical DLC expansion map for ARK: Survival Ascended.
features: Landscapes inspired by the Mediterranean coast, the serene beauty of cherry blossoms, and the rugged terrain of Appalachia.
Dozens of caves waiting to be explored.
Ancient Greek ruins and sacred temples scattered all over the map, and unique Greek inspired Obelisks.
Eight distinct regions each with unique biomes and creature variety, and unique features.
